description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer and copier for HashSet<T> in the Orleans.Serialization framework, including methods for serialization, deserialization, deep copying, and handling of internal references.

classes.name: HashSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for HashSet<T> implementing serialization, deserialization, and reference handling.

classes.name: HashSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for HashSet<T> supporting deep copy operations within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a HashSet<T> to the writer, including optional comparer and elements.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a HashSet<T> from the reader, reconstructing the set with proper reference handling.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the HashSet<T> elements and comparer.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into an existing HashSet<T> instance, handling size and comparer.

methods.name: HashSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a HashSet<T>.

methods.name: HashSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies elements from input HashSet<T> to output HashSet<T>.
